SHANGHAI.

"The Organisation of the Association for the Fostering of
the Movement for the Construction of a New National
Structure in Shanghai" has been drawn up as follows :-

will be concurrently the Chief of the Headquarters of this
movement.

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
REPORT

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
SP. BR. REGISTRY
File No. 395
S. 1. Special Branch / Shanghai
Date: October 16, 1940

Subject... Reported movement for a new Japanese political structure.

Made by... D. S. Hamashita Forwarded by... D. T. Crawford.

With reference to the attached translation
of an article appearing in the October 9th issue of
the "Shinko Shinpo", local Japanese daily, regarding a
leading organ being organized in the new political
structure, I have to state that the Japanese word
"Shintaisei" or "New Political Structure" is used
extensively by the Japanese people since the formation
of the present Konoye cabinet by Premier Prince
Fumimaro Konoye whose policy follows this line. That
such a new structure should be undertaken by the local
Japanese community to unite them into a body to meet
the present difficulties confronting Japan is the
opinion being expressed by various prominent individuals
among Japanese residents, but so far no concrete plan
has been proposed.

（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE COMMISSIONER'S OFFICE 17 OCT. 1940）

D. Hamashita
D. S.

D. S. (Special Branch).

Commandant of Police
Sir:
R. E. Cooke.

日期：1940年10月16日

主题... 关于建立日本新政治结构的动向报告。

制作人... D. S. Hamashita 转呈人... D. T. Crawford。

鉴于附件中译自10月9日当地日文日报《新交新报》（Shinko Shinpo）的一篇文章，内容涉及在新政治结构中组建一个领导机构，本人谨陈述如下：自近卫文麿首相组建现任近卫内阁以来，其政策遵循此路线，日本民众广泛使用“新体制”（Shintaisei）或“新政治结构”一词。当地日本侨民中的许多知名人士认为，应由当地日本社区着手建立这种新结构，将他们团结为一个整体以应对日本当前面临的困难，但迄今为止尚未提出具体计划。

（印：上海公共租界工部局警务处处长办公室 1940年10月17日）

D. Hamashita

October 9, 1940.

TAIRIKU· SHIMPO :-

"LEADING ORGAN OF NEW POLITICAL CONSTRUCTION MOVEMENT IN
SHANGHAI TO BE FORMED AT THE INITIATIVE OF JAPANESE
AMALGAMATED ASSOCIATION OF STREETS UNIONS"

Responding to the new political
construction movement in Japan, the Japanese Amalgamated
Association of Streets Unions will merge all local
civilian organizations into one powerful organ which will
lead the new political construction movement in Shanghai.
This leading organ will probably be
named "The Patriotic Duty Association for the Development
of Asia" (興亜奉公団 ) and will comprise the Japanese
Residents' Corporation, the Japanese Amalgamated Association
of Streets Unions, the Jikyoku-Fujin-Kai, the Kyofu-Kai,
the Shanghai Young Men's Association, the Self-reform
Society, the Ex-Service Men's Association in Shanghai, the
Koreans' Society etc.
The director of the organ will be
Mr. Horiuchi, Japanese Consul-General.
page_data.zh:
1940年10月9日。

《大陆新报》：-

“上海新政治建设运动领导机构将由日本各街道联合会合并协会发起成立”

为响应日本国内的新政治建设运动，日本各街道联合会合并协会将把所有当地民间组织合并为一个强有力的机构，以领导上海的新政治建设运动。该领导机构可能命名为“兴亚奉公团”，成员包括在留日本人会、日本各街道联合会合并协会、时局妇人会、协风会、上海青年会、自新社、上海退役军人协会、朝鲜人会等。该机构负责人将由日本总领事堀内先生担任。

page_data.en:
OUTLINE OF MAIN FEATURES OF THE NEW
SYSTEM OF ORGANIZATION

1. The Premier should hold the post of Chief
Executive of the New System of Organiza-
tion.

2. Those institutions in the Central Headquar-
ters are responsible for the direction
and organization of the people's move-
ments. The Economics and Cultural
Departments in the Administration Bureau
and the Supreme Economic Conference would
dissolve per se upon fulfilling the pur-
pose for which they were created. In
order to bring about the complete organ-
ization of the people, therefore, the
immediate problem is to ensure the perpet-
uity of those institutions.

3. Joint Conferences are the advisory organs of
the Chief Executive. Their existence is ab-
solutely necessary.

4. The Standing Committee have not yet reached a
decision as to the status of the Chiefs of
Branch Offices in Prefectures and that of
the Chiefs of Joint Conferences. The im-
mediate problem is therefore to consider
whether the Chief of a Prefecture should
concurrently hold the post of Chief of a
Branch Office in his Prefecture and in like
manner the Chief of a Branch Office in a
Prefecture should be concurrently the Chief
of the Joint Conference in his respective
Prefecture.

5. All Japanese subjects in support of the New
System of Organization are eligible as members.

6. The necessary expenditure will be met by members
and government subsidies.

（批：352 19 9 40）
（批：19/9/40 n）
page_data.zh:
新组织体系主要特征概要

1. 首相应担任新组织体系的首席执行官。

2. 中央总部内的各机构负责指导和管理民众运动。行政局下的经济部和文化部以及最高经济会议在完成其设立目的后将自行解散。因此，为了实现民众的全面组织化，当务之急是确保这些机构的永久性。

3. 联席会议是首席执行官的咨询机构。其存在绝对必要。

4. 常务委员会尚未就府县支部长及联席会议负责人的地位作出决定。因此，当务之急是考虑是否应由府县长官兼任其所在府县的支部长，同样，府县支部长也应兼任其所在府县的联席会议负责人。

5. 所有支持新组织体系的日本臣民均有资格成为会员。

6. 必要开支将由会员费和政府补贴支付。

（批注：352 19 9 40）
（批注：19/9/40 n）
